title: Fan-in integration pipeline
description: Objective: admit child result manifests, deduplicate closure, run a dedicated integrator, record semantic findings, and verify one all-required result. Deliverable: packages/integration modules and adversarial fixtures. NOT in scope: automatic semantic merge or ANY/QUORUM repository joins. Hard dependencies: Predecessor input materializer, Expansion admission protocol, and Evidence receipt pipeline. Owned paths: packages/integration/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/integration typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/integration test.
definitionOfDone: Every required child is accepted under its producing epoch before integration starts.
Duplicate transitive closure is applied once and semantic conflicts never disappear behind file-disjointness.
Integrated result receives fresh global verification and exact provenance.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.
